instruction:
I want VLC's video window to always stay on top of other windows when playing videos. Please enable the always-on-top feature.
How do I configure this setting?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's always-on-top feature (video-on-top=1). Created custom metric function check_vlc_always_on_top__850d1898. Expected value is 1 (enabled).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vlc_config reads VLC configuration file (vlcrc) which contains the video-on-top setting
Metric comparison logic is correct: check_vlc_always_on_top__850d1898 properly parses the config file, searches for 'video-on-top=' line, and compares value to expected
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling always-on-top feature, evaluator verifies video-on-top=1 in config file
Expected value is semantically correct: expected_always_on_top=1 matches VLC's config syntax for enabling the feature
Postconfig is appropriate: kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are written to disk before verification
Parameter handling is correct: metric directly accesses expected['expected_always_on_top'] which is correct for type='rule'
Data flow is logically sound: getter extracts config file → metric reads and parses it → compares video-on-top value
Edge case handling is robust: handles missing setting (defaults to '0'), FileNotFoundError, and general exceptions
